actions.action: Preserve immutable highlight evidence across revisions
actions.mechanism: Separate the original highlight and note from revision-specific attachments, preserving evidence when attachments change or disappear.
actions.implementation: Store original text, revision ID, offsets, and surrounding context. Append attachment decisions with source, destination, evidence, and status; never overwrite originals.
actions.check: Reattach a highlight twice, then verify its original text, revision, note, and both attachment decisions remain retrievable.
actions.risk: Retained revisions require storage and explicit retention rules.

actions.action: Find moved passages without guessing among duplicates
actions.mechanism: Search the entire revision for exact text; use surrounding context to distinguish candidates, not similarity alone.
actions.implementation: Enumerate exact occurrences and compare stored context. Automatically attach only an unchanged occurrence uniquely distinguished by that evidence; otherwise record ambiguous or missing.
actions.check: Move a paragraph and verify its evidence-backed attachment. Repeat identical sentences with identical context and verify neither is silently selected.
actions.risk: Context edits can leave legitimate moves unresolved.

actions.action: Track passage identity through recorded editing operations
actions.mechanism: When the editor is controlled, persistent text identities distinguish moves from identical copies without relying on textual resemblance.
actions.implementation: Assign text spans persistent IDs. Moves retain IDs; copies receive new IDs. Replay revision operations, but flag highlighted-text changes for review.
actions.check: Move an identified paragraph beside an identical copy: notes follow only the original. Change “must” to “may”: require review.
actions.risk: External imports without trustworthy operation history need fallback matching.

actions.action: Review changed passages and retain deleted annotations
actions.mechanism: Explicit unresolved states preserve notes, while side-by-side comparison makes changed wording visible before a reader authorizes attachment.
actions.implementation: Show original revision and text beside proposed passages with word-level differences. Offer confirm, choose another, or retain as deleted/unresolved; log decisions.
actions.check: Delete a highlighted passage: its note remains accessible without a destination. For “must” versus “may,” display the difference and require confirmation.
actions.risk: Review queues can grow; never resolve them through bulk guessing.
